high_level_description: One continuous side-view 2.5D pixel-art battle environment. The lower two thirds are a HORIZONTAL SLATE OR STONE FLOOR seen at an oblique angle, with broad irregular slabs foreshortened into wide shallow shapes. Never a vertical brick wall. All architecture stays at the top. Extend the existing scenery at the RIGHT naturally to the LEFT. Same ground plane, same material scale, same illumination and pixel clusters. The bare outer ash flats of the same wreck region. Broad level ash-grey basalt ground, quiet worn slabs partially buried in smooth dust. A low charcoal escarpment on the rear horizon. Only two small half-buried dark metal fragments at the RIGHT connect to the existing wreck field. Far LEFT is almost empty. No engines, huge wrecks or neon effects.

style_description.art_style: Crisp native pixel clusters, organic irregular shapes, subtly chipped edges, three or four flat tones per material. Broad quiet surfaces. Precise stepped pixel contours. Match the connected existing pixels on the right. No painted brush strokes, fine texture, dithering, blur or tiny gravel.
style_description.aesthetics: quiet connected ancient game environment, restrained detail, subdued low contrast ground
style_description.lighting: Even soft upper-left lighting in discrete pixel planes

compositional_deconstruction.background: Muted ash-grey basalt, dusty mauve, dark obsidian alloy, restrained violet seams. An alien hunter region in a war-torn lawless space wasteland. Continuous flat walkable ground across the whole lower two thirds. Camera slightly elevated SIDE battle view, not top-down or an isometric map. Ground extends to left, right and bottom. Quiet paving shapes about 60-140 pixels wide and 20-55 pixels deep, partly buried in dust; not gigantic slabs.

elements.desc: The bare outer ash flats of the same wreck region. Broad level ash-grey basalt ground, quiet worn slabs partially buried in smooth dust. A low charcoal escarpment on the rear horizon. Only two small half-buried dark metal fragments at the RIGHT connect to the existing wreck field. Far LEFT is almost empty. No engines, huge wrecks or neon effects. All obstacles confined to the rear upper third. No people or living statues.

A wide clear fighting plane with the same height and perspective as the adjoining right-hand ground. Irregular low-contrast paving interrupted by broad smooth dust. No hills, stairs, cliffs, holes, props or fencing in the battle lanes. No repeated square tile grid.
